Bug_Title: BAC: Bad Applet Constructor relies on uninitialized AppletStub (BAC_BAD_APPLET_CONSTRUCTOR)
Bug_Details:
This constructor calls methods in the parent Applet that rely on the AppletStub. Since the AppletStub
isn't initialized until the init() method of this applet is called, these methods will not perform
correctly.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the constructor of the BadAppletConstructor class where it attempts to call getParameter() before the AppletStub is initialized. This will result in incorrect behavior because the AppletStub is not ready at the time of construction.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by creating an instance of BadAppletConstructor, which calls the constructor that attempts to access the AppletStub before it is initialized. The getParameter() method call in the constructor fails silently and returns null, which is then returned by the showBug() method.
